title: Two byte order marks before the first document are two document prefixes
notes: A stream starts with any number of document prefixes (production 211, `l-document-prefix*`), and a prefix may be a byte order mark with no comment after it (production 202, `c-byte-order-mark? l-comment*`). So two marks are two prefixes and the bare document `a: 1` follows; section 5.2 allows a byte order mark at the start of any document. The marks are not content.
